game.title: DARK SOULS™: Prepare To Die™ Edition

roadmap.title: First bells and early vendors
roadmap.description: Keep boss souls and tail weapons. Rescue Griggs and Laurentius, buy their spells, and ring both bells.

roadmap.title: Anor Londo and Kaathe
roadmap.description: Get the Lordvessel after defeating Ornstein and Smough. The boss killed last gives you his soul; kill the other boss last in NG+. Leave the vessel unplaced until the Four Kings and Kaathe, then join Darkwraith.

roadmap.title: First-cycle collections and ending
roadmap.description: Get Darkmoon Blade before Gwyndolin, both Gravelord miracles and Leeroy's drops before Nito, and speak to Quelana before the Bed of Chaos. Shop with Rhea immediately after rescue. Finish sorceries, pyromancies, and reinforcement before the first ending.

roadmap.title: NG+ souls, miracles, and opposite ending
roadmap.description: Keep the same character. Offer the first Gwyn soul for Sunlight Spear, obtain the other Ornstein/Smough soul and second copies of shared crafting souls, then take the opposite ending.

roadmap.title: NG++ final Sif weapon
roadmap.description: Defeat Sif for a third soul, ring both bells, and return to the Giant Blacksmith in Anor Londo. Craft the remaining Artorias weapon and finish the rare-weapon collection.

achievements.description: All achievements completed. Congratulations!

steps.text: Complete every remaining achievement in this Steam version.

achievements.description: Reach the To Link the Fire ending.
achievements.summary: Reach the To Link the Fire ending.

guide.context: Choosing an ending starts NG+ immediately. Keep Gwyn's soul for Sunlight Spear, and select the opposite ending after your next Gwyn fight.

steps.text: Finish all first-cycle tail cuts, spell purchases, covenant rewards, upgrades, and optional bosses before entering the final fight. Offer the four Lord Souls at the @loc{Firelink Altar} to open the Kiln.
Defeat @enemy{Gwyn} in the @loc{Kiln of the First Flame}, then light the arena bonfire.

achievements.description: Reach the Dark Lord ending.

guide.context: This ending starts the next cycle. Save this second Soul of Gwyn for the Great Lord Greatsword.

steps.text: In NG+, obtain the second copies of the boss souls needed for weapons. Kill Ornstein and Smough in the opposite order from your first run. Finish Sunlight Spear and any missing purchases before the final fight.
Defeat @enemy{Gwyn}, then walk out through the arena entrance without lighting the bonfire.

achievements.description: Acquire all rare weapons.
achievements.summary: Acquire all 47 base-game rare weapons and shields on one character.

guide.context: Keep all collected weapons and boss souls on one character. Three Soul of Sif recipes require NG++; Collect two copies each of the souls from Moonlight Butterfly, Quelaag, Iron Golem, and Gwyndolin. Obtain Ornstein's and Smough's souls in different cycles. Reserve one Gwyn soul for Sunlight Spear and the other for his sword. Craft the final Sif weapon at the Giant Blacksmith in NG++.

collectibles.name: Moonlight Butterfly Horn
collectibles.method: Prepare the normal +10 bases with Andre using the Large Ember from The Depths. At the Giant Blacksmith, use Modify Equipment to combine one Soul of the Moonlight Butterfly with a spear or rapier +10.
collectibles.note: Save the boss soul for this recipe; use a spare base weapon so you do not consume another checklist item.

collectibles.name: Crystal Ring Shield
collectibles.method: Use Modify Equipment to combine one Soul of the Moonlight Butterfly with a shield +10.
collectibles.note: Save the boss soul for this recipe; use a spare base weapon so you do not consume another checklist item.

collectibles.name: Quelaag's Furysword
collectibles.method: Use Modify Equipment to combine one Soul of Quelaag with a curved sword +10.
collectibles.note: Save the boss soul for this recipe; use a spare base weapon so you do not consume another checklist item.

collectibles.name: Chaos Blade
collectibles.method: Use Modify Equipment to combine one Soul of Quelaag with a katana +10.
collectibles.note: Save the boss soul for this recipe; use a spare base weapon so you do not consume another checklist item.

collectibles.name: Greatsword of Artorias (Cursed)
collectibles.method: Use Modify Equipment to combine one Soul of Sif with a Dagger +10.
collectibles.note: Save the boss soul for this recipe; use a spare base weapon so you do not consume another checklist item.

collectibles.name: Greatsword of Artorias
collectibles.method: Use Modify Equipment to combine one Soul of Sif with a Broken Straight Sword +10 or Straight Sword Hilt +10.
collectibles.note: Save the boss soul for this recipe; use a spare base weapon so you do not consume another checklist item.

collectibles.name: Greatshield of Artorias
collectibles.method: Use Modify Equipment to combine one Soul of Sif with a shield +10.
collectibles.note: Save the boss soul for this recipe; use a spare base weapon so you do not consume another checklist item.

collectibles.name: Golem Axe

collectibles.note: Save the boss soul for this recipe; use a spare base weapon so you do not consume another checklist item.

collectibles.name: Dragon Bone Fist

collectibles.note: Save the boss soul for this recipe; use a spare base weapon so you do not consume another checklist item.

collectibles.name: Lifehunt Scythe
collectibles.method: Use Modify Equipment to combine one Soul of Priscilla with a halberd +10.
collectibles.note: Save the boss soul for this recipe; use a spare base weapon so you do not consume another checklist item.

collectibles.name: Dragonslayer Spear
collectibles.method: Use Modify Equipment to combine one Soul of Ornstein with a spear or rapier +10.
collectibles.note: Save the boss soul for this recipe; use a spare base weapon so you do not consume another checklist item.

collectibles.name: Smough's Hammer
collectibles.method: Use Modify Equipment to combine one Soul of Smough with a hammer +10.
collectibles.note: Save the boss soul for this recipe; use a spare base weapon so you do not consume another checklist item.

collectibles.name: Darkmoon Bow
collectibles.method: Use Modify Equipment to combine one Soul of Gwyndolin with a bow +10.
collectibles.note: Save the boss soul for this recipe; use a spare base weapon so you do not consume another checklist item.

collectibles.name: Tin Darkmoon Catalyst
collectibles.method: Use Modify Equipment to combine one Soul of Gwyndolin with a unupgraded Sorcerer's Catalyst.
collectibles.note: Save the boss soul for this recipe; use a spare base weapon so you do not consume another checklist item.

collectibles.name: Great Lord Greatsword
collectibles.method: Use Modify Equipment to combine one Soul of Gwyn, Lord of Cinder with a Dagger +10.
collectibles.note: Use the second Gwyn soul for this sword; offer the first for Sunlight Spear.

collectibles.name: Drake Sword
collectibles.method: Shoot the Hellkite Dragon's hanging tail from the lower bridge until the tail breaks.
collectibles.note: Killing the owner before the tail cut requires another cycle.

collectibles.name: Dragon King Greataxe
collectibles.method: Sever the Gaping Dragon's tail before killing the boss.
collectibles.note: Killing the owner before the tail cut requires another cycle.

collectibles.name: Priscilla's Dagger
collectibles.method: Sever Priscilla's tail before killing her. Strike the tail while she is visible.
collectibles.note: Killing the owner before the tail cut requires another cycle.

collectibles.name: Moonlight Greatsword
collectibles.method: Break Seath's crystal, then strike the tip of his rear tail until it severs. Do this before killing Seath.
collectibles.note: Killing the owner before the tail cut requires another cycle.

collectibles.name: Dragon Greatsword
collectibles.method: Attack the dragon's tail until the weapon drops; striking only the tail does not make this dragon hostile.

collectibles.name: Gravelord Sword
collectibles.location: The Catacombs, open coffin near the Titanite Demon.
collectibles.method: Carry an Eye of Death into the coffin, wait for transport, and join Nito's covenant before killing him.
collectibles.note: Join before the covenant leader becomes unavailable in the current cycle.

collectibles.name: Dark Hand
collectibles.location: The Abyss, after the Four Kings.
collectibles.method: Join Darkwraith through Kaathe with the Lordvessel not yet placed for Frampt. Alternatively, farm Darkwraith enemies in drained New Londo.

collectibles.name: Black Knight Sword
collectibles.method: Farm sword-wielding Black Knights.

collectibles.name: Black Knight Greatsword
collectibles.method: Farm greatsword-wielding Black Knights.

collectibles.name: Black Knight Greataxe
collectibles.method: Farm greataxe-wielding Black Knights.

collectibles.name: Black Knight Halberd
collectibles.method: Farm halberd-wielding Black Knights.

collectibles.name: Black Knight Shield
collectibles.method: Farm Black Knights until a shield drops.

collectibles.name: Channeler's Trident
collectibles.method: Farm the respawning Channelers.

collectibles.name: Crescent Axe
collectibles.location: Patches, Firelink Shrine or Tomb of the Giants.
collectibles.method: Buy from Patches for 10,000 souls after forgiving him, or collect the axe when you kill him.

collectibles.name: Crest Shield
collectibles.method: Kill hollow Oscar in the room where you originally received the Estus Flask.

collectibles.name: Giant's Halberd
collectibles.method: Buy for 5,000 souls.

collectibles.name: Silver Knight Straight Sword
collectibles.method: Farm sword-wielding Silver Knights.

collectibles.name: Silver Knight Spear
collectibles.method: Farm spear-wielding Silver Knights.

collectibles.name: Silver Knight Shield
collectibles.method: Farm Silver Knights until a shield drops.

collectibles.name: Stone Greatsword
collectibles.location: Darkroot Garden, before the Moonlight Butterfly.
collectibles.method: Farm the large Stone Knights.

collectibles.name: Stone Greatshield
collectibles.location: Darkroot Garden, before the Moonlight Butterfly.
collectibles.method: Farm the large Stone Knights.

collectibles.name: Grant
collectibles.location: Tomb of the Giants, cliff path before Nito.
collectibles.method: In human form, approach the cliff path and kill the invading Paladin Leeroy on solid ground. Loot his weapon.
collectibles.note: Nito must still be alive for Leeroy to invade. Avoid knocking Leeroy off the cliff.

collectibles.name: Sanctus
collectibles.location: Tomb of the Giants, cliff path before Nito.
collectibles.method: Loot Leeroy's shield from the same invasion before killing Nito.
collectibles.note: Nito must still be alive for Leeroy to invade. Avoid knocking Leeroy off the cliff.

collectibles.name: Astora's Straight Sword
collectibles.method: Take the weapon beside the sleeping Undead Dragon's hand.

collectibles.name: Dragon Crest Shield
collectibles.method: Take the shield beside the sleeping Undead Dragon's head.

collectibles.name: Dragon Tooth
collectibles.method: Strike the illusory wall at the fireplace near the second bonfire and open the basement chests.

collectibles.name: Havel's Greatshield
collectibles.method: Open the other equipment chests in the basement behind the fireplace.

collectibles.name: Dragonslayer Greatbow
collectibles.method: Exit through the broken upper window and drop down the exterior ledges to the corpse above the Giant Blacksmith.

collectibles.name: Black Iron Greatshield
collectibles.method: Loot the corpse to the left of the large painting.

collectibles.name: Velka's Rapier
collectibles.method: Get the Annex Key from the underground well area. Open the annex door, climb the stairs, and break the wooden barrier to reach the corpse.

collectibles.name: Bloodshield
collectibles.method: Loot the corpse beyond the Undead Dragon.

collectibles.name: Effigy Shield
collectibles.location: Tomb of the Giants, narrow side ledge.
collectibles.method: Beyond the first bonfire and fog, descend into the cave and take the right-hand side passage to the corpse.

achievements.description: Acquire all sorceries.
achievements.summary: Acquire all 24 base-game sorceries on one character.

guide.context: Owning the sorceries is enough; casting them is unnecessary. Complete vendor purchases before the first ending.

collectibles.name: Soul Arrow
collectibles.method: Buy the Residence Key from the male Undead Merchant in Undead Burg, then free Griggs from the locked room in Lower Undead Burg. With 10 Intelligence, buy Soul Arrow from him at Firelink for 1,000 souls.
collectibles.note: Buy before killing Griggs or ending the cycle.

collectibles.name: Great Soul Arrow
collectibles.method: Buy from Griggs for 6,000 souls.
collectibles.note: Buy before killing Griggs or ending the cycle.

collectibles.name: Heavy Soul Arrow
collectibles.method: Buy from Griggs for 2,000 souls.
collectibles.note: Buy before killing Griggs or ending the cycle.

collectibles.name: Great Heavy Soul Arrow
collectibles.method: Buy from Griggs for 8,000 souls.
collectibles.note: Buy before killing Griggs or ending the cycle.

collectibles.name: Aural Decoy
collectibles.method: Buy from Griggs for 1,000 souls.
collectibles.note: Buy before killing Griggs or ending the cycle.

collectibles.name: Fall Control
collectibles.method: Buy from Griggs for 1,500 souls.
collectibles.note: Buy before killing Griggs or ending the cycle.

collectibles.name: Magic Weapon
collectibles.method: Buy from Griggs for 3,000 souls.
collectibles.note: Buy before killing Griggs or ending the cycle.

collectibles.name: Magic Shield
collectibles.method: Buy from Griggs for 3,000 souls.
collectibles.note: Buy before killing Griggs or ending the cycle.

collectibles.name: Soul Spear
collectibles.location: The library beside the garden exit.
collectibles.method: In Sen's Fortress, direct a boulder into the wall behind the resting serpent to reach Logan's cage. Free him with the Master Key or the Cage Key from the isolated tower across the rooftop gap. In the Archives library, open the chest for the Archive Tower Giant Cell Key. Use this key to free Logan from the large prison cell. At his library shop, buy Soul Spear for 40,000 souls.
collectibles.note: Buy Logan's full stock before killing him; reload the library if he has not moved there.

collectibles.name: Homing Soulmass
collectibles.location: The library beside the garden exit.
collectibles.method: Buy from Logan for 20,000 souls.
collectibles.note: Buy Logan's full stock before killing him; reload the library if he has not moved there.

collectibles.name: Crystal Soul Spear
collectibles.location: The library beside the garden exit.
collectibles.method: Buy from Logan for 50,000 souls.
collectibles.note: Buy Logan's full stock before killing him; reload the library if he has not moved there.

collectibles.name: Homing Crystal Soulmass
collectibles.location: The library beside the garden exit.
collectibles.method: Buy from Logan for 30,000 souls.
collectibles.note: Buy Logan's full stock before killing him; reload the library if he has not moved there.

collectibles.name: Crystal Magic Weapon
collectibles.location: The library beside the garden exit.
collectibles.method: Buy from Logan for 20,000 souls.
collectibles.note: Buy Logan's full stock before killing him; reload the library if he has not moved there.

collectibles.name: White Dragon Breath
collectibles.method: Buy every sorcery in Logan's Archives stock, defeat Seath, and exhaust Logan's dialogue. Reload the area and kill hollow Logan in Seath's first arena.
collectibles.note: Killing Logan before his final move loses this drop for the cycle.

collectibles.name: Cast Light
collectibles.method: Kill the Hydra and reload the area. Defeat the golden golem in the back of the lake to free Dusk, answer Yes, and use her summon sign on the shore. Buy Cast Light for 1,000 souls.
collectibles.note: Avoid lingering attacks when freeing Dusk; killing her removes her shop.

collectibles.name: Repair
collectibles.method: Buy Repair for 10,000 souls.
collectibles.note: Avoid lingering attacks when freeing Dusk; killing her removes her shop.

collectibles.name: Hidden Body
collectibles.method: Buy Hidden Body for 2,000 souls.
collectibles.note: Avoid lingering attacks when freeing Dusk; killing her removes her shop.

collectibles.name: Hidden Weapon
collectibles.method: Buy Hidden Weapon for 2,000 souls.
collectibles.note: Avoid lingering attacks when freeing Dusk; killing her removes her shop.

collectibles.name: Chameleon
collectibles.method: Buy Chameleon for 3,000 souls.
collectibles.note: Avoid lingering attacks when freeing Dusk; killing her removes her shop.

collectibles.name: Resist Curse
collectibles.method: Climb the fireplace ladder inside the ghost-filled church and buy from Ingward for 5,000 souls.
collectibles.note: Buy before killing Ingward.

collectibles.name: Hush
collectibles.location: Sen's Fortress, below the boulder control room.
collectibles.method: Before the doorway into the boulder mechanism room, drop left onto the wooden platform and follow the passage to the corpse on the grating.

collectibles.name: Remedy
collectibles.method: Climb the waterwheel-side ladders and cross the tree branch to the chest beside the Crimson Set.

collectibles.name: Great Magic Weapon
collectibles.method: Strike the chain holding the chandelier from the rafters, then collect the sorcery from the fallen chandelier on the floor.

collectibles.name: Strong Magic Shield
collectibles.method: Turn the movable stairs to reach the upper chest directly above the Archives entrance.

achievements.description: Acquire all pyromancies.
achievements.summary: Acquire all 19 base-game pyromancies on one character.

guide.context: Keep one character for the full collection. Upgrade your Pyromancy Flame with Laurentius or Eingyi to +10 before approaching Quelana.

collectibles.name: Fireball
collectibles.method: Roll through the barrel holding Laurentius in The Depths to free him. At Firelink, answer No when he asks whether you find pyromancy unsavoury. Then buy Fireball for 800 souls.
collectibles.note: Buy before sending him to seek the source of advanced pyromancy; answer No when he asks about it.

collectibles.name: Fire Orb
collectibles.method: Buy Fire Orb for 8,000 souls.
collectibles.note: Buy before sending him to seek the source of advanced pyromancy; answer No when he asks about it.

collectibles.name: Combustion
collectibles.method: Buy Combustion for 500 souls.
collectibles.note: Buy before sending him to seek the source of advanced pyromancy; answer No when he asks about it.

collectibles.name: Iron Flesh
collectibles.method: Buy Iron Flesh for 2,000 souls.
collectibles.note: Buy before sending him to seek the source of advanced pyromancy; answer No when he asks about it.

collectibles.name: Flash Sweat
collectibles.method: Buy Flash Sweat for 2,000 souls.
collectibles.note: Buy before sending him to seek the source of advanced pyromancy; answer No when he asks about it.

collectibles.name: Great Fireball
collectibles.location: Beside a swamp pillar near Quelaag's approach.
collectibles.method: Bring a +10 Pyromancy Flame to the swamp and speak with Quelana before killing the Bed of Chaos. Buy Great Fireball for 20,000 souls.
collectibles.note: If Quelana has not appeared before the Bed of Chaos dies, return in NG+.

collectibles.name: Firestorm
collectibles.location: Beside a swamp pillar near Quelaag's approach.
collectibles.method: Buy Firestorm for 30,000 souls.
collectibles.note: If Quelana has not appeared before the Bed of Chaos dies, return in NG+.

collectibles.name: Fire Whip
collectibles.location: Beside a swamp pillar near Quelaag's approach.
collectibles.method: Buy Fire Whip for 10,000 souls.
collectibles.note: If Quelana has not appeared before the Bed of Chaos dies, return in NG+.

collectibles.name: Great Combustion
collectibles.location: Beside a swamp pillar near Quelaag's approach.
collectibles.method: Buy Great Combustion for 5,000 souls.
collectibles.note: If Quelana has not appeared before the Bed of Chaos dies, return in NG+.

collectibles.name: Undead Rapport
collectibles.location: Beside a swamp pillar near Quelaag's approach.
collectibles.method: Buy Undead Rapport for 10,000 souls.
collectibles.note: If Quelana has not appeared before the Bed of Chaos dies, return in NG+.

collectibles.name: Fire Tempest
collectibles.location: Beside the swamp pillar between the waterwheel and Quelaag's approach.
collectibles.method: Speak with Quelana and accept her request before killing the Bed of Chaos. Return after the victory to receive Fire Tempest.
collectibles.note: Keep Quelana alive and speak to her before the Bed of Chaos fight.

collectibles.name: Great Chaos Fireball
collectibles.location: Quelaag's Sister, behind the illusory wall below the bell.
collectibles.method: Accept membership in the Chaos Servant covenant.
collectibles.note: Obtain before killing Quelaag's Sister.

collectibles.name: Chaos Storm
collectibles.method: While in Chaos Servant, offer a total of 30 Humanity without leaving the covenant between offerings.
collectibles.note: Obtain before killing Quelaag's Sister.

collectibles.name: Toxic Mist
collectibles.method: Let an egg-carrying enemy in Demon Ruins grab you. Wait about five minutes for an egg head, then speak to Eingyi and buy Toxic Mist. Use his Egg Vermifuge afterward to cure the infection.
collectibles.note: Keep Eingyi alive until you have purchased the spell.

collectibles.name: Poison Mist
collectibles.method: From the swamp bonfire, head straight out to the large support pillar; search behind its left corner for the corpse.

collectibles.name: Power Within
collectibles.method: Take the pyromancy from beneath the giant wall parasite on the route toward The Depths.

collectibles.name: Acid Surge
collectibles.location: Painted World of Ariamis, cliffside courtyard.
collectibles.method: From the entrance courtyard, follow the right-hand cliff edge and search behind the wall.

collectibles.name: Fire Surge
collectibles.location: Painted World of Ariamis, underground passage.
collectibles.method: Climb down the courtyard well. Take left, left, left, then right to the stairs and kill the fire-breathing wall enemy.

collectibles.name: Chaos Fire Whip
collectibles.location: Lost Izalith, near the Bed of Chaos.
collectibles.method: Open the chest at the end of the side passage beside the boss fog.

achievements.description: Acquire all miracles.
achievements.summary: Acquire all 23 miracles on one character.

guide.context: Items and spells carry into NG+. Secure Nito's and Gwyndolin's covenant miracles before their first defeats, then finish Sunlight Spear with Gwyn's soul in NG+.

collectibles.name: Heal
collectibles.method: Buy from Petrus for 4,000 souls.
collectibles.note: Buy before killing Petrus; Rhea also sells these miracles after her rescue.

collectibles.name: Great Heal Excerpt
collectibles.method: Buy from Petrus for 10,000 souls.
collectibles.note: Buy before killing Petrus; Rhea also sells these miracles after her rescue.

collectibles.name: Homeward
collectibles.method: Buy from Petrus for 8,000 souls.
collectibles.note: Buy before killing Petrus; Rhea also sells these miracles after her rescue.

collectibles.name: Force
collectibles.method: Buy from Petrus for 4,000 souls.
collectibles.note: Buy before killing Petrus; Rhea also sells these miracles after her rescue.

collectibles.name: Seek Guidance
collectibles.method: Buy from Petrus for 2,000 souls.
collectibles.note: Buy before killing Petrus; Rhea also sells these miracles after her rescue.

collectibles.name: Replenishment
collectibles.location: Tomb of the Giants, the pit below Patches.
collectibles.method: Kill Rhea's hollow bodyguards Vince and Nico, then speak with Rhea.
collectibles.note: Keep Rhea alive during the rescue.

collectibles.name: Great Heal
collectibles.location: Undead Parish church, after rescuing Rhea.
collectibles.method: After receiving Replenishment, go directly to the church altar and buy Great Heal from Rhea for 10,000 souls.
collectibles.note: Petrus can kill Rhea after two further eligible boss victories; shop immediately after rescuing her.

collectibles.name: Wrath of the Gods
collectibles.location: Undead Parish church, after rescuing Rhea.
collectibles.method: After receiving Replenishment, go directly to the church altar and buy Wrath of the Gods from Rhea for 10,000 souls.
collectibles.note: Petrus can kill Rhea after two further eligible boss victories; shop immediately after rescuing her.

collectibles.name: Magic Barrier
collectibles.location: Undead Parish church, after rescuing Rhea.
collectibles.method: After receiving Replenishment, go directly to the church altar and buy Magic Barrier from Rhea for 6,000 souls.
collectibles.note: Petrus can kill Rhea after two further eligible boss victories; shop immediately after rescuing her.

collectibles.name: Emit Force
collectibles.method: Exhaust Siegmeyer's dialogue by the first boulder slope in Sen's Fortress. In Anor Londo, clear the adjacent room of its three Silver Knights and speak to him again. Later, answer Yes to him at Firelink.
collectibles.note: Complete these conversations before killing Siegmeyer or ending the cycle.

collectibles.name: Lightning Spear
collectibles.method: At 25 Faith, kneel at the broken statue and join Warrior of Sunlight.

collectibles.name: Great Lightning Spear
collectibles.method: Offer 10 Sunlight Medals while in Warrior of Sunlight. Farm Chaos Bugs in the Demon Ruins–Lost Izalith shortcut for offline drops.

collectibles.name: Sunlight Spear
collectibles.method: At Warrior of Sunlight rank 1, offer the Soul of Gwyn from your first ending. Keep the covenant active between earning rank 1 and making this offering.

collectibles.name: Gravelord Sword Dance
collectibles.method: Carry an Eye of Death into the open Catacombs coffin near the Titanite Demon. Wait for transport and join Gravelord Servant.
collectibles.note: Obtain before killing Nito in that cycle.

collectibles.name: Gravelord Greatsword Dance
collectibles.method: Offer 10 Eyes of Death while in Gravelord Servant. Farm Basilisks in The Great Hollow for more Eyes of Death.
collectibles.note: Obtain before killing Nito in that cycle.

collectibles.name: Darkmoon Blade
collectibles.method: Join Blade of the Darkmoon and offer 10 Souvenirs of Reprisal. Farm crow demons in the Painted World for offline drops.
collectibles.note: Obtain before crossing Gwyndolin's fog or killing him in that cycle.

collectibles.name: Karmic Justice
collectibles.method: After ringing the church bell, buy from Oswald of Carim for 40,000 souls.
collectibles.note: Keep Oswald alive until you have bought the miracle.

collectibles.name: Soothing Sunlight
collectibles.location: The Duke's Archives prison, bottom cell area.
collectibles.method: Kill the non-hostile Pisaca enemies beside Logan's large prison cell and collect their miracles.

collectibles.name: Bountiful Sunlight
collectibles.location: The Duke's Archives prison, bottom cell area.
collectibles.method: Loot the other miracle from the non-hostile Pisaca enemies beside Logan's large prison cell.

collectibles.name: Tranquil Walk of Peace
collectibles.method: Break the brick wall along the main descent, drop through the opening, then take the right-hand opening and climb the ladder to the corpse.

collectibles.name: Great Magic Barrier
collectibles.location: Ash Lake, hollow tree on the beach.
collectibles.method: Walk behind the first large hollow tree along the beach. Climb the sloping branch, drop into the open branch hole, and follow the interior ledge to the miracle.

collectibles.name: Vow of Silence
collectibles.location: Painted World of Ariamis, annex roof.
collectibles.method: Take the Annex Key from the underground well area and open the annex door. Climb to the roof guarded by crow demons and collect the miracle.

collectibles.name: Sunlight Blade
collectibles.method: After obtaining Darkmoon Blade, defeat Gwyndolin and open the chest beyond his arena.

achievements.description: Discover Way of White covenant.
achievements.summary: Discover the Way of White covenant.

guide.context: Keep Petrus and Rhea alive until you have discovered this covenant.

steps.text: At @loc{Firelink Shrine}, speak with @npc{Petrus} until he offers covenant membership, then accept.

achievements.description: Discover the Princess's Guard covenant.

guide.context: Killing Gwynevere removes her covenant offer for the current playthrough.

steps.text: Speak to @npc{Gwynevere} in the chamber above the @enemy{Ornstein and Smough} arena and accept her covenant offer.

achievements.description: Discover the Blade of the Darkmoon covenant.
achievements.summary: Discover the Blade of the Darkmoon covenant.

guide.context: Do not cross the fog until you have offered 10 Souvenirs of Reprisal for Darkmoon Blade. Farm the crow demons in the Painted World for these offerings.

steps.text: Take the @item{Darkmoon Seance Ring} from the coffin behind the giant skeleton in @loc{The Catacombs}.

Lower Anor Londo's rotating staircase to its bottom position. Equip the ring at the @loc{Darkmoon Tomb} bonfire to remove the statue, then kneel before the fog and accept @npc{Gwyndolin}'s covenant offer.

achievements.description: Discover the Warrior of Sunlight covenant.
achievements.summary: Discover the Warrior of Sunlight covenant.

guide.context: Online co-op is unavailable in this edition, so plan around the full 25 Faith requirement.

steps.text: Raise Faith to 25, then kneel at the broken statue beside the @loc{Sunlight Altar} bonfire under the Hellkite bridge in @loc{Undead Parish}.

achievements.description: Discover the Forest Hunter covenant.

guide.context: If a wrong answer or an attack makes the forest covenant hostile, request absolution from Oswald in the Undead Parish bell tower.

steps.text: Buy the @item{Crest of Artorias} from @npc{Andre} for 20,000 souls and open the sealed door in @loc{Darkroot Garden}.
Speak with @npc{Alvina}, the cat in the stone building, and answer Yes to her questions.

achievements.description: Discover the Darkwraith covenant.

guide.context: Placing the Lordvessel for Frampt first removes this opportunity until NG+. Acquiring the Lordvessel from Gwynevere is safe.

steps.text: After defeating the @enemy{Four Kings} with the Lordvessel still unplaced, speak to @npc{Kaathe} beside the Abyss bonfire and answer Yes.
Let Kaathe take you to the @loc{Firelink Altar}, place the Lordvessel, then speak with him again to return to the Abyss and accept his covenant offer.

achievements.description: Discover the Path of the Dragon covenant.
achievements.summary: Discover the Path of the Dragon covenant.

steps.text: Enter the large tree at the edge of the @loc{Blighttown} swamp. Strike the wall behind the treasure, then the wall behind the chest to reveal @loc{The Great Hollow}.
Descend to @loc{Ash Lake}, follow the beach to the @npc{Everlasting Dragon}, and accept its covenant offer.

achievements.description: Discover the Gravelord Servant covenant.

guide.context: Join and offer 10 Eyes of Death for Gravelord Greatsword Dance before killing Nito. Basilisks in The Great Hollow can drop Eyes of Death.

steps.text: In @loc{The Catacombs}, collect an @item{Eye of Death} behind the @enemy{Titanite Demon} in the long passage.
With an Eye of Death in your inventory, enter the open coffin in that passage and wait for transport. Speak to @npc{Nito} and accept the covenant.

achievements.description: Discover the Chaos Servant covenant.

guide.context: Keep Quelaag's Sister alive until you have received Great Chaos Fireball and offered 30 Humanity for Chaos Storm.

steps.text: Below the second bell, strike the illusory wall to find @npc{Eingyi} and @npc{Quelaag's Sister}.
Answer Yes to Eingyi, then speak to Quelaag's Sister and accept her covenant offer.

achievements.description: Acquire best weapon through standard reinforcement.

steps.text: Give the @item{Large Ember} from the chest beside the first Depths butcher to @npc{Andre}. Reinforce a normal weapon to +5, use Modify Equipment to ascend to +6, then reinforce to +10.
Collect the @item{Very Large Ember} from the upper chest reached by the spiral stairs in drained New Londo Ruins and give the ember to @npc{Andre} in @loc{Undead Parish}.
The Stray Demon in the revisited Undead Asylum drops a Titanite Slab; Darkwraiths in drained New Londo can drop more.
Use Andre's Modify Equipment menu to ascend the normal +10 weapon to +11. Reinforce to +14 with @item{Titanite Chunks}, then to +15 with a @item{Titanite Slab}.

achievements.description: Acquire best weapon through crystal reinforcement.

steps.text: Give the @item{Large Ember} from the chest beside the first Depths butcher to @npc{Andre}. Reinforce a normal weapon to +5, use Modify Equipment to ascend to +6, then reinforce to +10.
Collect the @item{Crystal Ember} from the chest in the Duke's Archives library near the movable-bookcase shortcut and give the ember to @npc{Giant Blacksmith} in @loc{Anor Londo}.
The Stray Demon in the revisited Undead Asylum drops a Titanite Slab; Darkwraiths in drained New Londo can drop more.
Use @npc{Giant Blacksmith}'s Modify Equipment menu to enter the Crystal path. Reinforce to Crystal +4 with @item{Titanite Chunks}, then use a @item{Titanite Slab} for +5.

achievements.description: Acquire best weapon through lightning reinforcement.

steps.text: Give the @item{Large Ember} from the chest beside the first Depths butcher to @npc{Andre}. Reinforce a normal weapon to +5, use Modify Equipment to ascend to +6, then reinforce to +10.
The Stray Demon in the revisited Undead Asylum drops a Titanite Slab; Darkwraiths in drained New Londo can drop more.
Use @npc{Giant Blacksmith}'s Modify Equipment menu to enter the Lightning path. Reinforce to Lightning +4 with @item{Titanite Chunks}, then use a @item{Titanite Slab} for +5.

achievements.description: Acquire best weapon through raw reinforcement.

steps.text: Reinforce a normal weapon to +5 with @item{Titanite Shards}.
Collect the @item{Large Ember} from the chest beside the first butcher in The Depths and give the ember to @npc{Andre} in @loc{Undead Parish}.
Use @npc{Andre}'s Modify Equipment menu to enter the Raw path. Reinforce to Raw +5 with @item{Large Titanite Shards}.

achievements.description: Acquire best weapon through magic reinforcement.

steps.text: Reinforce a normal weapon to +5, then ask @npc{Rickert} in @loc{New Londo Ruins} to modify it to Magic. Reinforce to Magic +5 with @item{Green Titanite Shards}.

Collect the @item{Large Magic Ember} from the chest in Seath's first Archives arena after defeating him in Crystal Cave and give the ember to @npc{Rickert} in @loc{the cell overlooking the first New Londo Ruins stairs}.

A Blue Titanite Slab lies at the end of a winding invisible side path in Crystal Cave. From the final main invisible crossing, turn back into the crystal-lizard cave and use Prism Stones to trace the side path. Collect another in NG+ or farm Crystal Butterflies in the cave.
Use @npc{Rickert}'s Modify Equipment menu to enter the Magic path at +6. Reinforce to Magic +9 with @item{Blue Titanite Chunks}, then use a @item{Blue Titanite Slab} for +10.

achievements.description: Acquire best weapon through enchanted reinforcement.

steps.text: Reinforce a normal weapon to +5, then ask @npc{Rickert} in @loc{New Londo Ruins} to modify it to Magic. Reinforce to Magic +5 with @item{Green Titanite Shards}.

Collect the @item{Enchanted Ember} from the pool chest guarded by large mushrooms in Darkroot Garden and give the ember to @npc{Rickert} in @loc{the cell overlooking the first New Londo Ruins stairs}.

A Blue Titanite Slab lies at the end of a winding invisible side path in Crystal Cave. From the final main invisible crossing, turn back into the crystal-lizard cave and use Prism Stones to trace the side path. Collect another in NG+ or farm Crystal Butterflies in the cave.
Use @npc{Rickert}'s Modify Equipment menu to enter the Enchanted path. Reinforce to Enchanted +4 with @item{Blue Titanite Chunks}, then use a @item{Blue Titanite Slab} for +5.

achievements.description: Acquire best weapon through divine reinforcement.

steps.text: Defeat the @enemy{Moonlight Butterfly} in @loc{Darkroot Garden} and collect the @item{Divine Ember} from the tower beyond it. Give the ember to @npc{Andre}, modify a normal +5 weapon to Divine, then reinforce to Divine +5 with Green Titanite Shards.
Collect the @item{Large Divine Ember} from the giant-skeleton chamber reached through a hole near the first Tomb of the Giants bonfire and give the ember to @npc{Andre} in @loc{Undead Parish}.
Take the White Titanite Slab from the side cave in the Pinwheel room just before Nito. For the second upgrade path, collect the slab again in NG+ or farm those Pinwheel enemies.
Use @npc{Andre}'s Modify Equipment menu to enter the Divine path at +6. Reinforce to Divine +9 with @item{White Titanite Chunks}, then use a @item{White Titanite Slab} for +10.

achievements.description: Reinforce a weapon to Occult +5.

steps.text: Defeat the @enemy{Moonlight Butterfly} in @loc{Darkroot Garden} and collect the @item{Divine Ember} from the tower beyond it. Give the ember to @npc{Andre}, modify a normal +5 weapon to Divine, then reinforce to Divine +5 with Green Titanite Shards.
Collect the @item{Dark Ember} from the petrified blacksmith in the Painted World's annex and give the ember to @npc{Andre} in @loc{Undead Parish}.
Take the White Titanite Slab from the side cave in the Pinwheel room just before Nito. For the second upgrade path, collect the slab again in NG+ or farm those Pinwheel enemies.
Use @npc{Andre}'s Modify Equipment menu to enter the Occult path. Reinforce to Occult +4 with @item{White Titanite Chunks}, then use a @item{White Titanite Slab} for +5.

achievements.description: Acquire best weapon through fire reinforcement.

steps.text: Take a normal +5 weapon to @npc{Vamos} in @loc{The Catacombs}. Modify the weapon to Fire, then reinforce to Fire +5 with Green Titanite Shards.
Collect the @item{Large Flame Ember} from the chest past the burrowing worms on the left-hand path before Demon Firesage and give the ember to @npc{Vamos} in @loc{The Catacombs}.
Take the Red Titanite Slab from the chest in the poisonous Chaos Eater pit in Lost Izalith. Collect another in NG+ or farm Chaos Eaters.
Use @npc{Vamos}'s Modify Equipment menu to enter the Fire path at +6. Reinforce to Fire +9 with @item{Red Titanite Chunks}, then use a @item{Red Titanite Slab} for +10.

achievements.description: Acquire best weapon through chaos reinforcement.

steps.text: Take a normal +5 weapon to @npc{Vamos} in @loc{The Catacombs}. Modify the weapon to Fire, then reinforce to Fire +5 with Green Titanite Shards.
Collect the @item{Chaos Flame Ember} from the lava pool behind the Taurus Demons in Demon Ruins and give the ember to @npc{Vamos} in @loc{The Catacombs}.
Take the Red Titanite Slab from the chest in the poisonous Chaos Eater pit in Lost Izalith. Collect another in NG+ or farm Chaos Eaters.
Use @npc{Vamos}'s Modify Equipment menu to enter the Chaos path. Reinforce to Chaos +4 with @item{Red Titanite Chunks}, then use a @item{Red Titanite Slab} for +5.

achievements.description: Light bonfire flame.

steps.text: Light the courtyard bonfire after leaving your cell in the @loc{Undead Asylum}.

achievements.description: Acquire Estus Flask.
achievements.summary: Receive the Estus Flask from Oscar.

steps.text: Let the rolling boulder break the wall in the @loc{Undead Asylum}, then speak to @npc{Oscar} through the opening.

achievements.description: Arrive in Lordran.

steps.text: Defeat the @enemy{Asylum Demon}, open the large exit doors, and climb the hill to the crow.

achievements.description: Ring Bell of Awakening at Undead Church.
achievements.summary: Ring the Bell of Awakening above the Undead Parish church.

steps.text: Defeat the @enemy{Bell Gargoyles} on the church roof, then climb the bell tower and pull the lever.

achievements.description: Ring Bell of Awakening in Quelaag's domain.
achievements.summary: Ring the Bell of Awakening in Quelaag's Domain.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Chaos Witch Quelaag} below @loc{Blighttown}, then pull the bell lever beyond her arena.

achievements.description: Acquire the Rite of Kindling.
achievements.summary: Obtain the Rite of Kindling by defeating Pinwheel.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Pinwheel} at the bottom of @loc{The Catacombs}.

achievements.description: Acquire the Art of Abysswalking.
achievements.summary: Obtain the Covenant of Artorias ring by defeating Great Grey Wolf Sif.

steps.text: Open the @item{Crest of Artorias} door in @loc{Darkroot Garden} and cross the forest to the large grave beyond the stone bridge. Defeat @enemy{Great Grey Wolf Sif}.

achievements.description: Arrive in Anor Londo.

steps.text: With both bells rung, cross @loc{Sen's Fortress} and defeat the @enemy{Iron Golem}. Touch the glowing ring in the arena to travel to @loc{Anor Londo}.

achievements.description: Acquire the Lordvessel.

guide.context: The boss killed last determines the soul you receive: leave Ornstein alive for his soul, or Smough for his. Reverse that choice in NG+ for the other weapon.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Ornstein and Smough}, then speak with @npc{Gwynevere} upstairs.

achievements.description: Defeat Gravelord Nito in the Tomb of the Giants.
achievements.summary: Defeat Gravelord Nito in the Tomb of the Giants.

steps.text: Finish the @npc{Gravelord Servant} rewards before entering Nito's arena: join for Gravelord Sword Dance and offer 10 Eyes of Death for Gravelord Greatsword Dance.
In @loc{Tomb of the Giants}, rescue @npc{Rhea} from the pit by killing her hollow bodyguards. Collect Replenishment, then immediately buy her miracles at the @loc{Undead Parish} church.
Before killing Nito, approach the narrow cliff path toward his arena in human form. Defeat the invading @enemy{Paladin Leeroy} on solid ground and collect @item{Grant} and @item{Sanctus}.
Continue through the Pinwheel enemies to the fog and defeat @enemy{Nito}.

achievements.description: Defeat the Bed of Chaos in Lost Izalith.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Bed of Chaos in Lost Izalith.

steps.text: Before this boss, bring a +10 @item{Pyromancy Flame} to the @loc{Blighttown} swamp and speak with @npc{Quelana} beside a pillar between the waterwheel and Quelaag's entrance. Buy her spells and accept her request.
Follow the @loc{Demon Ruins} route through Ceaseless Discharge, Demon Firesage, and Centipede Demon. Equip the @item{Orange Charred Ring} to cross the lava into @loc{Lost Izalith}.
In the @enemy{Bed of Chaos} arena, destroy the roots inside both side orbs. Drop onto the central branch below the broken floor, enter the tunnel, and strike the creature inside.
Return to Quelana for @item{Fire Tempest}.

achievements.description: Defeat the Four Kings in the Abyss.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Four Kings in the Abyss.

steps.text: Keep the Lordvessel unplaced. In @loc{New Londo Ruins}, use a @item{Transient Curse} to fight ghosts and climb the fireplace ladder to @npc{Ingward} on the church roof.
With the Lordvessel in your inventory, ask Ingward for the @item{Key to the Seal}. Use the key at the floodgate tower and turn the mechanism to drain New Londo.

Cross the lower ruins to the boss fog. Equip the @item{Covenant of Artorias} before dropping from the spiral stairs into the Abyss, and keep the ring equipped throughout the fight. Defeat the @enemy{Four Kings}.

achievements.description: Defeat Seath the Scaleless in the Crystal Cave.
achievements.summary: Defeat Seath the Scaleless in the Crystal Cave.

steps.text: After placing the Lordvessel, enter @loc{The Duke's Archives} from Anor Londo. Your first encounter with Seath ends in capture; escape the prison and reach the outdoor crystal golem garden.
Follow the @loc{Crystal Cave} route, using the falling snow to locate invisible walkways.
In the final arena, break the glowing crystal behind @enemy{Seath}. Cut the tip of his rear tail for @item{Moonlight Greatsword} before finishing the fight.

achievements.description: Defeat Dark Sun Gwyndolin in Anor Londo.
achievements.summary: Defeat Dark Sun Gwyndolin in Anor Londo.

steps.text: After obtaining @item{Darkmoon Blade} from covenant rank 1, cross the fog in @loc{Darkmoon Tomb} and defeat @enemy{Gwyndolin}. Use the pillars to shelter from his attacks.
Open the chest beyond the arena for @item{Sunlight Blade}.

achievements.description: Defeat Crossbreed Priscilla in the Painted World of Ariamis.
achievements.summary: Defeat Crossbreed Priscilla in the Painted World of Ariamis.

steps.text: Return to the @loc{Undead Asylum}: leave the Firelink-to-Parish elevator through its opening, jump from the ledge onto the sloping buttress, and climb to the crow's nest. Curl up and wait.
Take the @item{Peculiar Doll} from your starting cell, then examine the large painting on Anor Londo's cathedral floor.
Reach @enemy{Priscilla} at the end of the @loc{Painted World of Ariamis}. Attack her to begin the fight, sever her tail for @item{Priscilla's Dagger}, then defeat her.
